test_policy.scope: Primary improvement p-values and table stars
test_policy.missing_tests: No stars; retain their place in the planned Holm family

exploratory_two_sided.status: Post-hoc checks motivated by observed decreases; separate from primary improvement tests
exploratory_two_sided.test: Same paired CR1 patient-clustered t statistic and df; p = 2 * Student-t sf(abs(t), df)
exploratory_two_sided.multiplicity: Holm separately from primary tests, retaining each table full original comparison family
exploratory_two_sided.main_results_family: Three retrieval comparisons per generator/outcome; baseline excluded
exploratory_two_sided.generator_retrieval_gains_family: Both single sources across all generators and their average, per outcome
exploratory_two_sided.missing_tests: Unavailable checks remain missing and retain their Holm-family place
exploratory_two_sided.table_stars: Unchanged: determined only by primary one-sided improvement tests

main_results.holm_family: Three retrieval configurations within each generator/outcome

generator_retrieval_gains.holm_family: Two single-source configurations across all generators and their average, per outcome
generator_retrieval_gains.average: Average paired scores equally across the fixed generators within each case before patient clustering

group_retrieval_gains.holm_family: Nine tests: three retrieval configurations by three groups, within each generator/outcome
group_retrieval_gains.scope: Within-group improvement; not a test comparing gains between groups
group_retrieval_gains.plan_history_scope: Hypertension only; COPD reference Plans are unavailable

coverage_policy: Keep individual means only for fully scored eligible arms; suppress differences and inference if any eligible pair is missing. Unavailable Plan references are excluded.
